<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2017 Tehran attacks]]
**Thousands of people along with officials attend funerals held for victims of the attacks. [http://www.latimes.com/world/middleeast/la-fg-iran-attack-funerals-20170609-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')]
**President [[Hassan Rouhani]] says the attacks targeted peace and democracy. [http://www.presstv.com/Detail/2017/06/09/524690/Iran-Parliament-Mausoleum-Rouhani-Larijani/ (PressTV)]
*[[War in North-West Pakistan]]
**[[China|Chinese]] authorities report "grave concern" over reports that two kidnapped Chinese teachers in [[Quetta]], [[Pakistan]], were killed by members of the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant]]. [http://edition.cnn.com/2017/06/09/asia/pakistan-china-isis-teachers/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]
**[[Human rights activists]] accuse forces led by [[Saudi Arabia]] and the [[United Arab Emirates|UAE]] of kidnapping and torturing people during the [[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)|Yemeni conflict]]. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/06/uae-backed-forces-accused-forced-disappearances-170609195500415.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017)]]
**A suicide bomber at a market in [[Musayyib]] kills 31 and wounds 35. [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] claims responsibility. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-blast-idUSKBN19018K?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Cinema of the United States]]
**[[Adam West]], the actor widely known for playing [[Batman]] in the [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] series [[Batman (TV series)|of the same name]] during the 1960s, dies from leukemia. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-40235142 (BBC)]

;Business and economy
*[[Space launch market competition]]
**[[United Launch Alliance]] says it was not given an opportunity to bid against rival [[SpaceX]] for the upcoming launch of the U.S. Air Force [[Boeing X-37|miniature X-37B space plane]]. The  [[United States Air Force|Air Force]] declined to comment. [http://www.nydailynews.com/newswires/news/business/ula-not-allowed-compete-spacex-air-force-launch-article-1.3235989 (Reuters via ''New York Daily News'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[United Kingdom general election, 2017]]
**Results of yesterday's [[snap election]] are counted, revealing a [[hung parliament]] as the [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]] fails to retain its [[Majority government|parliamentary majority]], despite remaining the party with the most seats. Prime Minister [[Theresa May]] announced that she will form [[Second May ministry|a minority government]] with [[Con–DUP pact|the support]] of the Northern Irish [[Democratic Unionist Party]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/election-2017-40219030 (BBC)]
**Significant gains are made by the opposition [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] led by [[Jeremy Corbyn]], while the [[Scottish National Party]]'s dominance of Scottish seats is reduced. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2017/jun/08/general-election-results-2017-uk-live-labour-tories-corbyn-may-election-results-live-news-line (''The Guardian'')]
**[[UK Independence Party]] leader [[Paul Nuttall]] resigns; his party's share of the [[Popular vote (representative democracy)|popular vote]] of 1.8% was over 10 percentage points lower than in 2015. [https://www.independent.co.uk/News/uk/politics/election-results-latest-ukip-seats-vote-share-paul-nuttall-a7780406.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Politics of Japan]]
**The [[National Diet]] of [[Japan]] passes legislation allowing Emperor [[Akihito]] to [[abdication|abdicate]]. The abdication is to take place within three years. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-06-09/japan-emeperor-akihito-first-to-abdicate-in-200-years/8605342 (AP/Reuters via Aus. Broadcasting Corp.)]
*[[James Comey Senate Intelligence Committee testimony]]
**President [[Donald Trump]] claims that [[James Comey]] [[Perjury|committed perjury]] during his testimony yesterday, and offers to give his own testimony, [[perjury#Statutory definitions|"under oath,"]] refuting that he requested Comey to drop the Flynn investigation and that he had asked for Comey's allegiance. [https://www.nytimes.com/2017/06/09/us/politics/trump-comey.html (''The New York Times'')]
;Sports
*[[2018 FIFA World Cup qualification]]
**The [[Saudi Arabia national football team|Saudi Arabia national team]] provokes outrage for failing to observe a minutes silence at a [[2018 FIFA World Cup qualification – AFC Third Round|World Cup qualifier]] against [[Australia men's national soccer team|Australia]] at [[Adelaide Oval]]. The minute silence was in commemoration of the two Australian victims of the [[2017 London Bridge attack]]. The incident received condemnation from Australia's political leaders. [http://www.9news.com.au/national/2017/06/09/05/06/saudi-arabia-footballers-appear-to-ignore-minutes-silence-for-london-terror-attack-victims (Nine News)]
